_status: draft for expert review; fields containing "verify" are unconfirmed
name: QUAL2Kw (Washington State Dept. of Ecology; lineage QUAL2E -> QUAL2K -> QUAL2Kw)

v5_1.extras: genetic-algorithm auto-calibration (PIKAIA); Fortran exe qual2kw5.exe; manuals included

v6_0.flow: kinematic-wave non-steady, simulation of several days up to 1 year (control sheet has 'Simulation mode' = Repeating diel / dynamic; 'Number of days for the simulation period')
v6_0.extras: COD, Total N, Total P, Total CBODu columns in 'WQ Output'; hyporheic and surface transient storage options; sediment diagenesis option

xqual2kw.purpose: calibrates against several surveys at once

versions.version_locked: v6.0 for new projects (has COD/TN/TP outputs and non-steady option); v5.1 accepted for steady cases
versions.reason: TT 95/2025 needs COD, BOD5, TN, TP; v6 writes COD, Total N, Total P directly

platform.interface: Excel workbook with VBA macros (inputs, run, charts, outputs)

engine.fortran: qual2kw5.exe (v5.1) optional; must sit in the same folder as the .xls and keep its name; results identical to VBA, faster

platform.data_file: .q2k plain-text file written at every run (name from cell B9 of sheet QUAL2K; extension added automatically); reopened with 'Open Old File'
platform.linux_mac: not supported for the run step; QGIS-side preparation and result reading run anywhere
verify: whether qual2kw5.exe can be started from the command line on a .q2k file without Excel (strings show dynamic.txt and message.dat; not tested)

v6 Fortran exe: confirmed to exist (qual2kw6.exe, 1,821,184 bytes, PE32 console i386, banner 'QUAL2KW version 6.0', sha256 24a7d85e...c6); whether it takes a .q2k path on the command line is NOT visible in its strings, needs a run on Windows

routes.A_file_route: plugin writes a .q2k (text) -> expert opens it in Excel with 'Open Old File' -> Run -> plugin reads result sheets
routes.B_workbook_route: plugin fills the pale-blue/yellow input cells of the workbook with openpyxl/xlwings -> expert runs macro
routes.C_com_route: on Windows the plugin drives Excel via COM (xlwings) to press Run

integration.collect: read 'WQ Output' (distance-wise table, one row per reach/element) and diel sheets; draw profiles in QGIS
integration.export: xlsx for the report (the workbook itself or a plugin-made summary)

rates.auto_calibration: columns E-G of sheet Rates, genetic algorithm PIKAIA; runtime >= np*(ngen+1) model runs

calibration_data.observed_wq_profile: needed; TT 95/2025 Art. 9.5 requires calibration and validation

inputs.generic_constituent: optional; if set 'use as COD' = non-carbonaceous non-nitrogenous COD in mgO2/L, oxidised with first-order decay and subtracted from DO

mapping_to_vn_parameters.total_N: model column 'Total N (ug/L)' (organic N + NH4 + NO3 + nitrite)
mapping_to_vn_parameters.COD: v6 column 'COD (mgO2/L)' exists; how it is built from CBODu, detritus and the generic-as-COD option must be read from the v6 documentation

BOD5.inputs: headwater and sources are given as fast CBOD ~ 1.46 x BOD5 (decay k ~ 0.23 /d, Brown & Barnwell 1985); better to use CBOD5 (carbonaceous part) x 1.46
BOD5.outputs: to report BOD5 from model, convert CBODfast (+ slow share) back with the 5-day relation; expert approves (level B)
BOD5.warning: Vietnamese BOD5 (TCVN/QCVN lab) includes nitrogenous demand unless inhibited; state which one is meant

mapping_to_vn_parameters.rule: plugin never silently converts; each conversion is a recorded expert decision

sheets_v6: WQ Output (constituent summary, diel mean, per reach with distance km)
Diel water column / hyporheic / fluxes sheets
outputs.to_tt95: model concentration at segment end replaces Cnn+Lt effects in Ltn formula; exact use of model output in TT 95 Art. 9.3 still open

limits: 1-D, well mixed vertically and laterally; not for wide/stratified waters
tidal reach with salinity >= 4 permille: TT 95/2025 demands a model, but QUAL2Kw is not an estuarine hydrodynamic model -> flag; expert decides or uses another model
v5.1 steady flow; v6 kinematic-wave non-steady only
needs observed profile data to calibrate/validate
Windows + Excel only for the run step

validation.test_cases: Boulder Creek example (BC_1987-08-21.q2k and workbook) shipped in the zip
validation.accept_when: plugin-prepared input reproduces the shipped example outputs (same reach table, same predicted profiles)
validation.also: calibration/validation record attached to the audit trail

open_questions: Can qual2kw5.exe (or a v6 engine) run from a .q2k file without Excel? If yes, the run step becomes scriptable
Cell map of each input sheet for route B (needs a pass over the v6 workbook)
COD derivation in v6 (documentation not in the uploaded files; check Ecology page)
